title: Mixing: Open Your Box by Yoko Ono/Plastic Ono Band | 1971
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono/Plastic Ono Band’s song ‘Open Your Box’ was remixed at Abbey Road Studios on 4 March 1971.

The song had first been mixed on 23 February, but was reworked on this day due to concerns raised by EMI over its lyrical content.

‘Open Your Box’ was released as the b-side of the ‘Power To The People’ single.
